title: Protection warrior: engages each of three loose mobs and claps them

rules.desc: A mob that hits the healer (extra1) or the DPS player gets any cast from the Protection warrior on that mob within 6 s, at least 70 percent of the time (one trigger per mob per 8 s)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:126-138 (lose aggro and party member attacked taunt rows at INTERRUPT + 1); ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:341-354 (loose adds near -> challenging shout, melee medium aoe -> battle shout taunt); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: one taunt per 10 s cooldown cannot cover three loose mobs; taunt on attacker and the AoE rows carry the spread. Expected UNKNOWN on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: The Protection warrior casts Thunder Clap at least once in the fight
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:161-166 (melee light aoe -> thunder clap at ACTION_HIGH + 7, #949); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: two or more mobs in melee hold the light-aoe row active for the whole pack fight, and the clap outranks the single-target builders. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: At most 40 percent of the mob damage events (hits counted, not amounts) land on the healer or the DPS player; the rest on the tank
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:126-138,148-150,161-166 (taunt rows, shield block, thunder clap); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: an outcome: the player opens all three mobs, so each lands opening hits before the taunts and the clap spread the threat. Expected UNKNOWN on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
